title: powertoys can no longer update automatically

actions.label: Request updater diagnostics
actions.note: Ask for the exact updater phase and fresh diagnostics needed to triage the update failure.

comment.body:
Thanks for adding the screenshots. I re-checked the issue, but the current report still does not tell us **which updater stage** is actually failing. To narrow this properly, please provide the following:

1. **Exact updater result** — After you press **Check for updates**, please describe the exact text you see (for example: no update available, checking failed, update offered but install fails, etc.).
2. **Install channel** — Please confirm whether this install came from the GitHub installer, Microsoft Store, or WinGet, and whether prerelease updates are enabled.
3. **Fresh updater diagnostics** — Please reproduce the problem from **Settings > General > Updates**, then immediately comment `/bugreport` so the generated ZIP captures the updater logs from that attempt.

Those details will tell us whether this is expected channel behavior or a real update discovery/download/install bug.

issue_context.summary: The screenshots suggest a PowerToys update concern, but the current report does not reveal whether the problem is “no update offered”, “check failed”, or “update detected but not applied”.
known_information: The issue is on PowerToys 0.100.2 and says the install method is PowerToys auto-update.
Three screenshot attachments exist across the issue body and comments.
No bug report ZIP, installer log, or textual error message is provided.
A follow-up commenter told the reporter to check the release notes, which may mean the screenshots were interpreted without channel context.
inferences: This may be an updater bug, but it may also be confusion about release availability or channel selection.
Without logs or a textual error, there is not enough evidence to tell whether the failing stage is discovery, download, install, or relaunch.
issue_context.analysis: The next step is a precise updater repro request, not a design. The reporter already provided screenshots, so the maintainer follow-up should focus on the missing textual result and diagnostics.
initial_investigation: Re-read the screenshots references and comments; the issue still contains no textual updater error.
Checked repository history and confirmed updater work exists, but nothing in the current report pins the failure to one updater phase.
The absence of a bug report ZIP means there is no current Update log evidence to inspect.

information_gaps.information: The exact updater result shown in the UI: “no update available”, “checking failed”, an offered version that will not install, or another specific message.
information_gaps.why_needed: That separates release-availability confusion from a real updater transport/install bug.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please describe exactly what the update page says in text after you press Check for updates.

information_gaps.information: Whether this install came from the GitHub installer, Store, or WinGet path and whether prerelease updates are enabled.
information_gaps.why_needed: Update behavior differs by install channel and release ring, so this determines whether the screenshots reflect expected channel behavior.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please confirm the install source and whether prerelease updates are enabled in PowerToys settings.

information_gaps.information: A fresh PowerToys diagnostics bundle captured immediately after reproducing the update problem from Settings.
information_gaps.why_needed: The Update logs inside the diagnostics bundle are the only reliable way to see whether discovery, download, install, or relaunch failed.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please reproduce the update problem from Settings > General > Updates, then immediately comment `/bugreport` so the generated ZIP captures the updater logs from that attempt.

judgment.rationale: The current report is screenshots-only and does not say whether the updater says “no update”, fails while checking, or detects an update and then cannot apply it, so the failure mode is still ambiguous.
evidence: The body and follow-up comments only add screenshots; no diagnostic ZIP or installer log is attached.
The reporter is on 0.100.2 and says PowerToys auto-update is the installation method.
A commenter explicitly says to check the release notes, implying the current screenshots may reflect channel/availability confusion rather than a transport failure.
PowerToys has prior updater work in history (`Fix auto-update relaunch...`), but the current issue does not include the log evidence needed to map this report onto a specific updater stage.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask for one fresh updater-specific diagnostics capture and a precise description of what the update UI reports.

fix_assessment.rationale: No current fix path is defensible until the updater failure mode is narrowed to availability, download, install, or relaunch.
